title: BYLT
shortDescription: Website for a Performance Marketing agency in London, featuring 3D effects and scroll-based animations.
fullDescription: An immersive website built for BYLT, a Performance Marketing agency based in London. The project combines interactive 3D effects with scroll-driven animations, creating an engaging visual experience that reflects the agency's innovative approach to digital marketing.
problem: The agency needed a website that communicated creativity and technical expertise, standing out from the competition with a memorable web experience.

title: Chess Bot
shortDescription: Chess bot trained with Machine Learning, capable of analyzing positions and playing competitive games.
fullDescription: An intelligent chess engine developed using Machine Learning techniques. The bot was trained on thousands of games to recognize strategic patterns, evaluate positions, and generate optimal moves, offering a challenging opponent at various difficulty levels.
problem: Creating an accessible chess opponent that combined the power of ML with an intuitive interface for players of all levels.
features: ML model trained on thousands of games

title: Production Ready To Do App
shortDescription: Production-ready To Do app built with Next.js, featuring robust error handling and full test coverage.
fullDescription: A To Do application built with the goal of being fully production-ready. The project demonstrates software engineering best practices: comprehensive error handling, unit and integration tests, CI/CD pipeline, and a scalable architecture.
problem: Demonstrating that even a seemingly simple project requires serious engineering when the goal is production-grade quality.
features: Comprehensive error handling with error boundaries
